Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Bid Terms and Condition 1) Inspection: The supplies are subject to inspection and acceptance of items at the Buyer's site. 2) Liquidated Damages (LD): If the Seller fails to deliver any or all of the Goods/Ser vices within the original Delivery period specified in the Contract, the Buyer will be entitled to

deduct/recover Liquidated Damages for the delay, @ 0.5% per week or part of the we ek of delayed period, as pre-estimated damages not exceeding 10% of the contract valu e. Contract Lead time for application of LD will be as per the Lead Time mentioned in B uyer Purchase Order and Buyer Premises Gate Entry date will be considered as the “Date of Supply”. 3) Payment Terms: 100% Payment Within 45 Days from the date of receipt and acc eptance of goods as per contract scope and terms without any deviation and proper documentation including invoice, bank details etc. 4) Delivery : a) The tentative delivery dates are specified in the Bid. Any change in delivery requirement will be notified 45 days in advance. b) Any late deliveries done by the supplier, if previously accepted by buyer, will be subject to Liquidated Damages as stipulated. c) Any late/early deliveries without prior consent by buyer may be rejected at Buyer’s discretion. 5) Packing: a) The supply must be made in good quality Packing for transportation and storing at Buyers premises. b) The Supplier will be held responsible for tropical storage and for transport of the drums by rail, road, sea or air so as to ensure their being free from loss or injury on arrival at their destination. c) The quality of the packing shall be adequate enough for internal handling by buyer . d) Individual packing must have proper identification, including Shelf Life details. e) Inappropriate packing may result in rejection of the items. 6) Rejection Clause: In case of Rejection, a) The supplier has to collect all the rejected goods from Buyer’s premises within 15 days of intimation from Buyer. OR Proper arrangements with necessary authorization need to be made by suppliers for the return of rejected items from Buyer stores. b) In case of Rejections and Return, the supplier has to bear cost of transportation, including the return of rejected goods and supply of new/replacement goods on “FOR , Buyers Premise” basis. c) If such cost is incurred by Buyer, supplier has to transfer such specified amount as per Buyer intimation to Buyer’s designated bank account within specified time limits, or else, such amount will be recovered from pending bills (including that of any division of Buyer). d) Failure to comply will result in appropriate action by buyer without further notice, particularly if a suitable replacement is not provided on an “FOR, Buyers Premise” basis. 7) Specification: The Item must comply with all specifications and any additional requirements indicated in the bid. 8) Proprietary Article: Item is of proprietary in nature. Hence suppliers having vali d Authorised Distributor Certificate can only participate in the bidding process. Any bid

without valid “Authorised Distributor Certificate” will be disqualified on Technical Grounds. 9) Quality Documents: MSDS (Material Safety Data Sheet), Manufacturer's/OEM Certificate of Conformance (CoC) and Test Reports from government-accredited laboratories mu st be provided with all supplies. 10) Shelf Life: Items with a shelf life must have a minimum of 80% shelf life remain ing upon receipt at Buyer’s Premises. Individual items must be packed separately and must be clearly labelled with Batch Number, Cure Date and Shelf Life details. 11) Risk purchase: The Seller will supply quality Item as per the specifications finali zed and also the quantity intended by the concerned Division in full as per terms and conditio ns of respective orders. In case the Seller fails to execute the order in time either in terms of quality or in quantity, Buyer reserves the right to procure from elsewhere at the risk and cost of the Seller and any extra expenditure incurred due to this purchase is payable by the Seller. 12) Repeat Order: Buyer shall have right to place Direct (Out of GeM) Repeat Order (Single Order or Multiple Orders totalling to 100% value of the original order) at any time aft er placement of the original order, but within 12 months from the date of completion of the original order. The Prices, Terms and Conditions of the repeat order shall be the s ame as that of the original order. 13) ISO45001:2018: Buyer insists the Seller to comply with all the applicable Health and safety laws and regulations as per Indian factories act-1948. 14) ISO14001:2015: Buyer insists the Seller to comply with all the applicable Enviro nmental laws and regulations as a minimum to Pollution control board requirements as applic able. The Seller or third interested party should make efforts to adhere to the Environment , Health and Safety (EHS) requirements as per applicable standards. 15) Right to Access: Buyer, its Customers and Regulatory Authorities have the righ t to access Seller’s manufacturing facilities or of Seller’s sub-contractors and verify the process with respect to ordered materials and related record with respect to QMS adopted to cont ract the manufacturing process. .
